notes.title: DYNAROG V1.1 WAR MACHINE UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]War Machine Update[/b]

This is the first Dynarog Update ! lot of your feedbacks has been earded and applied ^^
Have fun !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41130251/ae6e56496ba029ee54e244f749d93416c21465f6.png[/img]

[b]Added :[/b]
[u]Gameplay and Improvements[/u]
- Heat System and Steam Cooling Gameplay
- Optional Final Boss to end a run (multi phases)
- 5 new soundtrack (including Final boss theme)
- Achievements !!
- Dynastyrog Room (good luck) (totaly not inspired by an other game)

[u]Features[/u]
- Enemy Indicators around player
- Scoring System (global score and Difficulty score)
- Notification System
- Walking sound

[b]Changes :[/b]
- Trinket are destroyed if not taken at the end if the floor (to avoid trinket stacking)
- Loot automaticaly come to the player 
- Difficulty curve has been adjusted
- Maniability has been improved


[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
- Player would be teleported at the spawner if leaving an active room
- Trinket interaction sometime didn't work
- Trinket was Stacked together if not taken when changing floor
- Green Boss sometime didn't attack player 
- Post Explosion trinket wasn't working
- Some navigation / interactions issues with Gamepad

notes.title: BETA 1.1A
notes.content:
[b]Dynarog Version 1.1A War Machine Update  is nearly finished ![/b]

Beta version is open to everyone !
to acces it, simply set Profil to "Beta" in Game settings from your Steam Library

[b]MAIN FEATURES :[/b]
- Optional Final boss to end your run !
- New Mechanic for a multiple Weapons : Weapon Jamming
Some weapon can now be jammed after a shot and player need to spam shoot to unlock it


[b]Added :[/b]
- Final Boss
- New Weapon : Bolt Gun
- New Weapon : Gauss Cannon
- New Weapon : Railgun
- Enemies Indicators around player
- Added 4 new musics
- Weapon Jamming


[b]Changes :[/b]
- Player robot now have walkings sound effect
- Stark and Panzerbot Class has been modified


[b]Fixed issues :[/b]
- Reloading sometimes was displaying 100% and was still reloading
- When you had less than 1 ammo max, reloading was looping
- When you bought weapons or special weapons, it could trigger the equiped weapon
- Some bosses Attacks wasn't dealing damages
- Post Explosion trinket wasn't working

notes.title: Dynarog 2 Patch 1.0C
notes.content:
[b]Dynarog Patch 1.0C[/b]

[b]Added :[/b]
 - Notification System
 - New Drone

[b]Fixed bugs :[/b]
 - Game now pause when Gamepad is disconeted
 - Navigation issue in Trinket Choice Menu with Gamepad
 - Repair station's UI now scale properly
 - Drones now Reload properly when out of ammo

[b]Changes :[/b]
 - Menu background now run as a video to avoid perf issues
 - Price ajustement for Special Weapons
 - Loot amount has been slightly raised
 - Drone swarm special Weapon can now be bought


[b]Upcomming Changes :[/b]
 - Enemies indicator (directions) similar to Dynarog 1
 - New special weapons
 - Mousse issue on small screen resolution


Has you can see, many of your feedbacks has been taken in consideration ^^
I can't suggest you enough to continue ! It help ME giving YOU the game you want !

I'm still working on Keybinding system but having some difficulties  right now.
I don't know when it will be added to the game but i'm doing some test and hope to figure out what the problem is.
